direction: abeam, travelling with her southward along the locked doors of the west wall; doors pass right to left through frame
speed: about 0.55 m/s, locked to her walking pace — three to four door bays inside one continuous frame
start_frame: Travelling medium abeam of Alice from the centre of the hall: her hand already closing on the first large black iron handle, one horseshoe-arched oak door and its blind stained-glass roundel filling the background.
end_frame: The identical abeam framing three or four bays further down the west wall: her hand hitting the last handle of the pass, the same arches, handles and dado still passing at the same rate — the wall visibly unchanged and still locked.
constraint_honoured: 'The door round is two shots, not twenty: the repetition is compressed into the move instead of into cuts.'
movement_note: Licensed move (a), following her walk. This is the reference half of the S05/S09 match pair: same 40 mm, same axis, lens height 1.30 here and 0.55 at sh089, so the same wall will take three times as long to pass when she is a third the size.
